title: Implement local-command LLM operations

context.summary: Implement local-command model calls for all Mindory LLM roles.
context.background: Local-command must be a real provider for model operations, not only a healthcheck surface.

in: Define request and response JSON contracts for all local-command model roles.
Implement chat, text embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision captioning, image embeddings, face detection, face recognition, image generation and audio generation.
Add timeout, concurrency and audit handling.
Add fake command fixtures and SDK tests for each role.
Update LLM docs and installer prompts.

acceptance_criteria: Every configured local-command role can execute a real command and parse a typed result.
Role failures produce structured model errors and audit entries.
Generated image and audio results can be saved by callers without special-case code.

manual_checks: Confirm command stdout/stderr handling is bounded and secrets are redacted.

risks: Large binary payloads must be passed through safe file references or bounded base64 payloads.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
